text: Use keep-both for conflicts: never drop a version. Add a test with two offline edits, then update the row.
Should keep-both show a merge screen, or save the second copy as a new note titled with the device name? I recommend the second option for 0.4.
Search should ignore accents. Low priority until sync is done.
Beta 0.4 ships with sync and search only. Export moves to 0.5.
